docs.title: Hengzhuo Glove Data Glove User Manual
1. Environment Preparation
docs.text: The sensors in the Hengzhuo Glove data glove contain magnetometers, which can be affected by strong magnetic fields. Users must operate the sensors in an environment with minimal magnetic interference.

docs.title: 2. Device Connection
docs.text:
First-time setup: Hengzhuo Glove glove (sufficiently charged), receiver, and Motion Studio software.

2.1 Connecting the Receiver

Plug the data glove receiver into your computer.

2.2 Powering On and Activating the Sensors

Press and hold the power button. When the green indicator light on the glove sensor illuminates, the device has powered on successfully.

docs.title: 2.3 Installing the Software
docs.text:
1. Run the installation package and follow the prompts to install. You may customize the installation path.

#

2. Click Browse to choose a custom installation path. Installing in the default path is recommended.

3. After setting the installation path, click Install. The software will be installed automatically in the background.

4. Once installation is complete, a Motion Studio icon will appear on the desktop.

# 2.4 Launching the Program

After opening Motion Studio, click New Project to create a project. We also provide a sample project dataset for reference.

# In the new project, customize the project name and storage location. After creating the project, click Confirm to finish creating it. # Once the new project is open, you will enter the software main interface to begin operating:

Click the Connect button to connect the glove to the Motion Studio software.

After a successful connection, the glove node on the device details page will light up, and a glove model will appear on the main page.

Put on the glove and click Pose Calibration to calibrate the glove.

### T-Pose • Stand straight, extend your arms so they are perpendicular to your upright body, with palms facing down.

• Straighten your fingers and keep the four fingers together.

### OK-Pose • Place both hands about 30 cm in front of your chest.

• Make an "OK" gesture.

Once calibration is complete, you can begin motion capture.

### 2.5 Device Grouping ### When both glove devices and full-body devices are connected, users can click "Device Management" in the Functions menu to freely group the glove devices with full-body devices.

Click Device Management and the following dialog will appear.

Move the mouse over the device you want to group and click Group.

After selecting the devices to group, click Confirm.

When the two grouped devices appear within the same frame, grouping is successful and you can start using them.

### 3. BVH Data Broadcasting The data broadcasting feature can transmit data from Motion Studio to third-party software, or broadcast data in real time across the network where Motion Studio is running. Any other software on that network can receive and parse the live data through the API interface.

When a motion capture device is connected in real time, turn on the "BVH" button (the button turning from gray to orange indicates it is enabled) and enter a custom port number to begin real-time data broadcasting.

4. Compatibility

The Hengzhuo Glove data glove supports single-user and multi-user interaction, is compatible with 6DoF tracking technologies such as OptiTrack and HTC VIVE Tracker, and adapts to a variety of PC-VR headsets and VR all-in-one devices, ensuring users a seamless, high-quality VR experience. It is suitable for scenarios such as gaming, exhibitions, education, and industrial simulation. Whether for consumers seeking an extreme experience or enterprise users requiring a professional-grade solution, Hengzhuo Glove provides flexible options and an immersive VR experience. For detailed compatibility steps, see the Hengzhuo Glove data glove plugin documentation. ## 5. Parameter Introduction # 6. Precautions 1. Do not use or store the Hengzhuo Glove glove near heat sources (such as fire or heaters);

2. Please use the original charging cable and charging case to charge;

3. Do not immerse the glove in water or get it wet;

4. Do not heat the glove;

4. Do not strike, throw, or subject the glove sensors to mechanical vibration;

5. Do not hammer or step on the glove sensors;

6. Do not disassemble the glove sensors in any way;

7. Do not charge the glove sensors near fire or under extreme heat;

8. Please use the original adapter to power the glove sensors. Low-quality adapters may damage the glove sensor battery.
